contract a disease: Travelers who drink unsafe water in some areas may contract a disease that can make them seriously ill.
在某些地區喝了不安全的水的旅客，可能會染病而病得很嚴重。
the economy contracted: During the pandemic, the economy contracted sharply because many shops and factories were forced to close.
疫情期間，由於許多商店和工廠被迫關閉，經濟大幅萎縮。
muscles contract: When you lift something heavy, your arm muscles contract and become shorter and harder.
當你舉起重物時，你的手臂肌肉收縮，變得更短也更硬。
contract a worker: Instead of hiring a full-time employee, the company decided to contract a worker for the six-month project.
公司決定不雇用全職員工，而是為這個為期六個月的專案簽約聘人。
contract debts: He began to contract debts in college when he used several credit cards to pay for expensive clothes.
他在大學時用好幾張信用卡買昂貴的衣服，從此開始負債。
contrast A with B: In her essay, Lily tried to contrast life in the busy city with life on her grandparents' quiet farm.
在她的作文中，莉莉試著將繁忙的城市生活與祖父母安靜農場的生活作對比（對比A與B）。
in contrast to: In contrast to her quiet and shy sister, Amy loves talking to strangers and making new friends.
與她安靜害羞的姐姐相反，艾美喜歡和陌生人聊天、結交新朋友。
contrast sharply: The bright, modern buildings contrast sharply with the old temples standing right next to them.
明亮現代的建築和緊鄰在旁的古老廟宇形成強烈對比。
contribute to the problem: Throwing plastic bags into the ocean will only contribute to the problem of marine pollution.
把塑膠袋丟進海裡只會導致海洋汙染的問題更嚴重。
contribute money: After the earthquake, thousands of people chose to contribute money to help the families who lost their homes.
地震過後，成千上萬的人選擇捐錢幫助失去家園的家庭。
contribute to society: Many retired teachers still want to contribute to society by tutoring poor children for free.
許多退休老師仍想透過免費為貧困孩童課輔來貢獻社會。
contribute an article: Every student is invited to contribute an article to the school magazine before the end of the month.
每位學生都受邀在月底前向校刊投稿一篇文章。
contribute ideas: During the meeting, the manager encouraged everyone to contribute ideas for the new advertising campaign.
開會時，經理鼓勵每個人為新的廣告活動提供想法。
convert to Buddhism: After living in a temple in Thailand for a year, the American writer decided to convert to Buddhism.
在泰國的寺廟住了一年後，這位美國作家決定改信佛教。
convert the garage into a studio: Since they no longer had a car, they decided to convert the garage into a studio for painting.
因為他們不再有車，所以決定把車庫改成畫畫用的工作室。
convert dollars into yen: Before flying to Tokyo, you should convert dollars into yen at the bank to get a better rate.
飛往東京之前，你應該在銀行把美元換成日圓，以取得較好的匯率。
convert fans into customers: The online shop uses special discounts to convert fans into customers who actually buy its products.
這家網路商店用特別折扣把粉絲變成真正購買產品的顧客。
convey a message: The poster uses simple pictures to convey a message about saving water to young children.
這張海報用簡單的圖畫向幼童傳達節約用水的訊息。
convey one's feelings: Some shy students find it easier to convey their feelings in a letter than face to face.
有些害羞的學生覺得用信表達感受比當面說容易。
convey passengers: The small ferry can convey passengers between the two islands about six times a day.
這艘小渡輪每天大約可在兩座島之間載運乘客六趟。
convey the impression: Arriving late to an interview may convey the impression that you do not care about the job.
面試遲到可能會給人一種你不在乎這份工作的印象。
be convicted of theft: The man was convicted of theft after police found the stolen jewelry hidden in his car.
警方在他車上發現藏著的失竊珠寶後，這名男子被判竊盜罪。
convict the defendant: The evidence was so strong that the judge had no choice but to convict the defendant.
證據非常確鑿，法官別無選擇只能判被告有罪。
convince someone of: After the money went missing, it took Tom a long time to convince his boss of his honesty.
錢不見之後，湯姆花了很久才說服老闆相信他是誠實的。
convince the jury: The lawyer showed the video from the security camera to convince the jury that her client was innocent.
律師播放監視器畫面，以說服陪審團她的當事人是無辜的。
a convincing argument: With clear facts and strong evidence, Kevin made a convincing argument that the school should ban plastic straws.
凱文以清楚的事實和有力的證據，提出了學校應該禁用塑膠吸管的有說服力的論點。
cope with stress: Many students go jogging or listen to music to cope with stress before the big exam.
許多學生在大考前會慢跑或聽音樂來應付壓力。
cope with loss: After her grandfather passed away, Jenny wrote in a diary every night to cope with loss and sadness.
祖父過世後，珍妮每晚寫日記來面對失去與悲傷。
can't cope: With three part-time jobs and final exams next week, Ben feels he can't cope anymore.
身兼三份打工，下週又要期末考，班覺得自己撐不下去了。
cope with demand: The bakery hired five more workers to cope with demand for its pineapple cakes before the holidays.
這家麵包店多請了五位員工，以應付節日前鳳梨酥的需求。
